en.headline: Unions name labour slates as Election Committee nominations open
en.dek: The Federation of Trade Unions is fielding 46 candidates and the Federation of Labour Unions 12 for the 60 elected labour seats.
body: The Hong Kong Federation of Trade Unions is fielding 46 union representatives for the labour subsector of the Election Committee election, and the Federation of Labour Unions is fielding 12, as the nomination period opened on Wednesday.

The FTU list includes Kwok Wai-keung and Luk Chung-hung, who sat as ex-officio members while they were legislators and failed to win re-election to the Legislative Council last year. Ming Pao reported that 23 of the 46 won labour seats at the last election. The candidates come from unions covering tunnels, rail and trams, seafarers and logistics, utilities, tourism, catering, retail, hotels, textiles, manufacturing and construction, among others.

The FTU said its platform has 13 points, including priority employment for local workers and a crackdown on illegal labour. The Federation of Labour Unions said it hoped to bring labour voices into Hong Kong's first five-year plan.
The labour subsector has 60 seats, all filled by election. Nominations run until 20 October. Where the number of candidates exceeds the seats, polling is set for 22 November.

zh.headline: 工聯會派46人、勞聯派12人參選選委會勞工界
zh.dek: 選委會界別分組選舉提名期周三開始。工聯會名單包括去年立法會選舉未能連任的郭偉強及陸頌雄。
body: 選舉委員會界別分組選舉提名期周三展開。工聯會派出46名工會代表參選勞工界，勞聯派出12人。
工聯會名單包括郭偉強及陸頌雄。兩人曾以立法會議員身分出任當然委員，去年立法會選舉未能連任。明報報道，46人當中有23人在上屆勞工界當選。名單來自汽車隧道、鐵路電車、海員物流、公共事業、旅遊、飲食、零售、酒店、紡織、製造及建造等工會。
工聯會提出13項政綱，包括堅持本地勞工優先就業，以及打擊非法勞工。勞聯表示，希望團結勞工，為香港首個五年規劃出力。
勞工界設60席，全部由選舉產生。提名期至10月20日。若某個界別報名人數多於議席，將於11月22日投票。
